item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 10/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the next couple of days. Temperatures will fall progressively over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Under the influence of replenishments of the intense northeast monsoon, the weather will be persistently rather cool over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
